exposure: Maternal thyroid function (TSH and FT4 levels)
cohort: Low-risk Caucasian women, pregnant with a single cephalic fetus
finding: Increased TSH and decreased FT4 levels throughout pregnancy were associated with an increased risk of operative delivery, particularly due to failure to progress in the second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Increased TSH and decreased FT4 seem to be associated with more operative vaginal deliveries and Caesarean sections.
